# Jeremiah 35 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 35:14 (overlap: 23%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "The-words-of Jonadab son-of Rechab which he-commanded his-sons not to-drink wine are-carried-out, and-they-have-not-drunk to this day, for they-obeyed the-command-of their-father. But-I spoke to-you, rising-early and-speaking, and-you-did-not listen to-Me." |
| LOGOS | "The command that Jonadab the son of Rechab gave to his sons, to drink no wine, has been kept, and they drink none to this day, for they have obeyed their father's command. I have spoken to you persistently, but you have not listened to Me." |
| PNEUMA | "The descendants of Jonadab son of Rechab have obeyed their ancestor's command completely. They still refuse to drink wine to this day. But I have spoken to you again and again, and you refuse to listen to Me." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
